title: Mus Saib Yeeb Yam
blurb: Four friends, two tickets, one movie — a story for practising every pronoun: wb, neb, nkawd and the rest.

paragraphs.hmong: Hnub no, kuv thiab kuv cov phooj ywg yuav mus saib yeeb yam hauv tsev ntsia yeeb yam.
paragraphs.english: Today, my friends and I are going to watch a movie at the movie theater.

paragraphs.hmong: Peb pab muaj plaub leeg, yog kuv, Fong, Mai, thiab Nraug.
paragraphs.english: Our group has four people: me, Fong, Mai, and Nraug.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv thiab Fong yog wb ob leeg, hos Mai thiab Nraug yog nkawd ob leeg.
paragraphs.english: Fong and I are “wb ob leeg” (the two of us), while Mai and Nraug are “nkawd ob leeg” (the two of them).

paragraphs.hmong: Peb plaub leeg tau npaj mus saib yeeb yam no tau ob peb hnub lawm.
paragraphs.english: All four of us have been preparing to watch this movie for several days.

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum peb tseem nyob hauv tsev, kuv nug Fong tias, “Fong, koj puas npaj koj lub hnab lawm?”
paragraphs.english: While we were still at home, I asked Fong, “Fong, have you prepared your bag yet?”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv npaj kuv lub hnab lawm, ces wb mus tau.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “Yes, I have prepared my bag, so the two of us can go.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Mai tias, “Mai, koj puas nqa koj daim pib lawm?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Mai, “Mai, have you brought your ticket yet?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv nqa kuv daim pib lawm.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, I have brought my ticket.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Nraug tias, “Nraug, koj puas muaj koj daim pib thiab?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Nraug, “Nraug, do you have your ticket too?”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv muaj kuv daim pib.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug answered me, “Yes, I have my ticket.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yog li, peb plaub leeg thiaj tawm hauv tsev ua ke.
paragraphs.english: So, the four of us left the house together.

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum peb plaub leeg los txog ntawm tsev ntsia yeeb yam, Mai thiab Nraug mus sawv tos ntawm qhov rooj.
paragraphs.english: When the four of us arrived at the movie theater, Mai and Nraug went ahead to wait at the entrance.

paragraphs.hmong: Nkawd twb yuav nkag mus rau hauv, vim nkawd twb muaj nkawd daim pib lawm.
paragraphs.english: The two of them were already about to go inside because they already had their tickets.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Mai tias, “Mai, koj thiab Nraug tos wb ntawm no ib pliag.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Mai, “Mai, you and Nraug wait here for us for a moment.”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb yuav tos neb ntawm no.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, we two will wait for you two here.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug kuj hais rau wb tias, “Wb yuav tos neb kom peb thiaj nkag mus ua ke.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug also said to us, “We two will wait for you two so that all four of us can go inside together.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Fong tias, “Fong, wb mus nrhiav tus neeg muag daim pib.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Fong, “Fong, the two of us will go find the ticket seller.”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb mus tam sim no.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “Yes, the two of us will go now.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum wb mus hauv chav tos, kuv pom ib tug txiv neej zaum tom qab lub rooj muag daim pib.
paragraphs.english: When we two went into the waiting area, I saw a man sitting behind the ticket counter.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws yog Yaj, tus neeg muag daim pib.
paragraphs.english: He was Yaj, the ticket seller.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv taug kev mus cuag Yaj, hos Fong taug kev nrog kuv.
paragraphs.english: I walked over to Yaj, and Fong walked with me.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Yaj tias, “Yaj, koj puas muag daim pib yeeb yam?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Yaj, “Yaj, do you sell movie tickets?”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv muag daim pib.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj answered me, “Yes, I sell tickets.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Yaj tias, “Wb xav yuav ob daim pib rau wb ob leeg.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Yaj, “The two of us want to buy two movie tickets.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj saib wb, ces nws nug wb tias, “Neb puas tuaj neb ob leeg xwb, los yog neb tuaj nrog lwm tus neeg?”
paragraphs.english: Yaj looked at the two of us, and then he asked us two, “Are you two here by yourselves, or did you come with other people?”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb Yaj tias, “Wb tuaj nrog wb ob tug phooj ywg.”
paragraphs.english: I answered Yaj, “The two of us came with our two friends.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj saib wb dua, ces nws nug kuv tias, “Koj tuaj nrog leej twg?”
paragraphs.english: Yaj looked at the two of us again, and then he asked me, “Who did you come with?”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb nws tias, “Kuv tuaj nrog Fong, Mai, thiab Nraug.”
paragraphs.english: I answered him, “I came with Fong, Mai, and Nraug.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv qhia nws tias, “Peb plaub leeg los txog ua ke, tiam sis Mai thiab Nraug twb muaj nkawd daim pib lawm.”
paragraphs.english: I told him, “The four of us arrived together, but Mai and Nraug already have their tickets.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj hais rau wb tias, “Kuv pom nej plaub leeg los txog ua ke.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj said to the two of us, “I saw the four of you arrive together.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Yaj tias, “Yaj, vim li cas koj ho nug wb txog qhov ntawd?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Yaj, “Yaj, why did you ask us that?”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws teb kuv tias, “Kuv nug vim kuv xav paub seb neb puas xav zaum ze nkawd.”
paragraphs.english: He answered me, “I asked because I want to know whether you two want to sit near the two of them.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws ntxiv tias, “Kuv pom nej plaub leeg yog ib pab phooj ywg, ces kuv xav nrhiav ob lub rooj zaum ze nkawd rau neb.”
paragraphs.english: He continued, “I saw that the four of you are a group of friends, so I want to find two seats near the two of them for you two.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb Yaj tias, “Yog, wb xav zaum nrog wb ob tug phooj ywg.”
paragraphs.english: I answered Yaj, “Yes, the two of us want to sit with our two friends.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv xav paub tus lej rooj zaum ntawm Mai thiab Nraug, tab sis kuv tsis paub.
paragraphs.english: I wanted to know Mai and Nraug’s seat numbers, but I did not know them.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv tig mus nug Fong tias, “Fong, koj puas paub nkawd zaum ntawm tus lej twg?”
paragraphs.english: I turned to Fong and asked Fong, “Fong, do you know which numbers the two of them are sitting in?”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Kuv tsis paub thiab, wb rov mus nug nkawd.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “I do not know either, so the two of us should go ask them.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Fong tias, “Yog, wb rov mus nug nkawd tam sim no.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Fong, “Yes, the two of us will go ask them right now.”

paragraphs.hmong: Ces wb ob leeg rov mus cuag Mai thiab Nraug.
paragraphs.english: Then the two of us went back to Mai and Nraug.

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum wb mus txog ntawm ntawd, nkawd tseem tos wb.
paragraphs.english: When we got there, the two of them were still waiting for us.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Mai tias, “Mai, koj puas qhia tau wb paub neb tus lej rooj zaum?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Mai, “Mai, can you tell the two of us your two seat numbers?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv qhia tau.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, I can.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Mai ntxiv tias, “Koj thiab Nraug zaum ntawm tus lej twg?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Mai, “Which numbers are you and Nraug sitting in?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Kuv zaum ntawm rooj 12, hos Nraug zaum ntawm rooj 13.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “I am sitting in seat 12, while Nraug is sitting in seat 13.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Mai tias, “Koj puas muaj koj daim pib kom kuv saib?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Mai, “Do you have your ticket so I can look at it?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Tau, kuv muab kuv daim pib rau koj.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Sure, I will give my ticket to you.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws muab daim pib ko rau kuv, thiab kuv saib tus lej ntawm daim pib ko.
paragraphs.english: She handed me this ticket, and I looked at the number on this ticket.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Mai tias, “Daim pib ko puas yog koj daim pib?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Mai, “Is this ticket your ticket?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, daim pib ko yog kuv daim pib.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, this ticket is my ticket.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug kuj muab nws daim pib rau wb, thiab nws hais rau wb tias, “Daim pib ntawd yog kuv daim pib.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug also handed his ticket to us, and he said to us, “That ticket is my ticket.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv saib daim pib ntawd, thiab kuv pom tus lej 13 ntawm nws.
paragraphs.english: I looked at that ticket, and I saw the number 13 on it.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv muab ob daim pib rov qab rau nkawd.
paragraphs.english: I gave the two tickets back to the two of them.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau nkawd tias, “Ua tsaug rau neb, wb paub neb tus lej rooj zaum lawm.”
paragraphs.english: I said to the two of them, “Thank you, you two. Now the two of us know your seat numbers.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv tig mus rau Fong, ces kuv hais rau nws tias, “Fong, koj puas nco rooj 12 thiab rooj 13?”
paragraphs.english: I turned to Fong, and I said to him, “Fong, do you remember seats 12 and 13?”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv nco lawm, ces wb rov mus qhia Yaj.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “Yes, I remember, so the two of us should go tell Yaj.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Mai tias, “Mai, koj thiab Nraug tos wb ntawm no.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Mai, “Mai, you and Nraug wait here for us.”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb yuav tos neb.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, we two will wait for you two.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Nraug tias, “Nraug, koj nyob ntawm no nrog Mai.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Nraug, “Nraug, you stay here with Mai.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv nyob ntawm no.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug answered me, “Yes, I will stay here.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum wb rov qab mus cuag Yaj, nws tseem zaum ntawm nws lub rooj muag daim pib.
paragraphs.english: When the two of us went back to Yaj, he was still sitting at his ticket counter.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Yaj tias, “Yaj, wb twb paub nkawd tus lej rooj zaum lawm.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Yaj, “Yaj, now the two of us know their seat numbers.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws nug wb tias, “Neb puas paub nkawd lub rooj zaum?”
paragraphs.english: He asked us two, “Do you two know their seats?”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb nws tias, “Yog, Mai zaum ntawm rooj 12, thiab Nraug zaum ntawm rooj 13.”
paragraphs.english: I answered him, “Yes, Mai is sitting in seat 12, and Nraug is sitting in seat 13.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj saib nws daim ntawv, thiab nws nrhiav cov rooj nyob ze ntawm ntawd.
paragraphs.english: Yaj looked at his list, and he looked for seats near those numbers.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Yaj tias, “Koj puas muaj ob lub rooj zaum nyob ze ntawm ntawd rau wb?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Yaj, “Do you have two seats near there for the two of us?”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv muaj ob lub rooj zaum nyob ze nkawd.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj answered me, “Yes, I have two seats near the two of them.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug nws tias, “Koj puas yuav muag ob daim pib ntawd rau wb?”
paragraphs.english: I asked him, “Will you sell those two tickets to us?”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj teb wb tias, “Yog, kuv muag tau ob daim pib rau neb.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj answered us two, “Yes, I can sell two tickets to you two.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj muab ob daim pib yeeb yam rau wb, thiab wb muab nyiaj rau nws.
paragraphs.english: Yaj gave the two movie tickets to us, and we gave him the money.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nqa kuv daim pib, hos Fong nqa nws daim pib.
paragraphs.english: I took my ticket, while Fong took his ticket.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Yaj tias, “Ua tsaug rau koj.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Yaj, “Thank you.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws teb wb tias, “Neb txais tos, thiab neb yuav tau zaum ze nkawd.”
paragraphs.english: He answered the two of us, “You are welcome, and you two will be able to sit near them.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj hais rau wb tias, “Kuv pom nej plaub leeg los txog ua ke, thiab kuv xav kom nej plaub leeg nyob ze ib leeg.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj said to the two of us, “I saw the four of you arrive together, and I want the four of you to stay close to one another.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws qhia wb tias, “Kuv yuav nrhiav rooj ze nkawd kom nej plaub leeg thiaj pom yeeb yam zoo.”
paragraphs.english: He told the two of us, “I will find seats near the two of them so that the four of you can watch the movie comfortably.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum wb qhia tus lej rooj rau nws, nws hais tias, “Cov rooj ntawd nyob ze nkawd ob leeg.”
paragraphs.english: When the two of us gave him the seat numbers, he said, “Those seats are near the two of them.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj muab cov ntaub ntawv rau wb thiab hais tias, “Kuv xav kom nej plaub leeg tsis txhob sib nrug.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj gave the two of us the information and said, “I do not want the four of you to be separated.”

paragraphs.hmong: Wb ob leeg nqa wb daim pib rov mus cuag Mai thiab Nraug.
paragraphs.english: The two of us took our tickets back to Mai and Nraug.

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum wb mus txog ntawm qhov rooj, nkawd tseem tos wb.
paragraphs.english: When we got to the entrance, the two of them were still waiting for us.

paragraphs.hmong: Mai nug wb tias, “Neb tau daim pib lawm los?”
paragraphs.english: Mai asked us two, “Did you two get the tickets?”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb Mai tias, “Yog, wb tau lawm.”
paragraphs.english: I answered Mai, “Yes, the two of us got them.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv qhia kuv daim pib rau nkawd, thiab Fong kuj qhia nws daim pib rau nkawd.
paragraphs.english: I showed my ticket to the two of them, and Fong also showed his ticket to them.

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug saib Fong daim pib, hos Mai saib kuv daim pib.
paragraphs.english: Nraug looked at Fong’s ticket, while Mai looked at mine.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau nkawd tias, “Tam sim no peb plaub leeg yuav tau zaum ze ua ke.”
paragraphs.english: I said to the two of them, “Now all four of us can sit close together.”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv zoo siab tias peb tau zaum ua ke.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, I am happy that all four of us can sit together.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug kuj hais tias, “Kuv kuj zoo siab thiab.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug also said, “I am happy too.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau nkawd tias, “Neb ob leeg khaws neb daim pib kom zoo.”
paragraphs.english: I said to the two of them, “You two should keep your tickets safe.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj kuj hais rau peb tias, “Nej plaub leeg yuav tau nyob ze ib leeg thaum nej nkag mus.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj also said to all four of us, “The four of you will need to stay close to each other when you go inside.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws nug peb tias, “Nej puas xav kom kuv nrhiav rooj zaum kom nej plaub leeg nyob ze ib leeg?”
paragraphs.english: He asked all four of us, “Do you want me to find seats so that the four of you can stay near one another?”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj piav rau peb tias, “Nej plaub leeg twb tuaj ua ke lawm, ces nej yuav tau zaum ua ke.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj explained to all four of us, “All four of you came together, so all four of you should sit together.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum peb rov los cuag nws, nws saib peb dua thiab nug tias, “Nej puas tau npaj txhij lawm?”
paragraphs.english: When all four of us came back to him, he looked at all four of us again and asked, “Are all four of you ready?”

paragraphs.hmong: Ua ntej peb nkag mus, nws hais rau peb tias, “Nej khaws nej daim pib kom zoo.”
paragraphs.english: Before all four of us went inside, he told all four of us, “Keep your tickets safe.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum peb plaub leeg nkag mus rau hauv chav saib yeeb yam, kuv coj Fong mus rau ntawm wb ob lub rooj.
paragraphs.english: When all four of us entered the movie room, I led Fong to our two seats.

paragraphs.hmong: Fong mus nrog kuv, hos Mai thiab Nraug mus nrhiav nkawd cov rooj.
paragraphs.english: Fong went with me, while Mai and Nraug went to find their two seats.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv pom nkawd cov rooj nyob ze wb, ces kuv hu nkawd tias, “Mai thiab Nraug, neb cov rooj nyob ntawm ntawd.”
paragraphs.english: I saw that their seats were near ours, so I called to the two of them, “Mai and Nraug, your seats are over there.”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb pom lawm.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, we see them.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug hais rau wb tias, “Wb yuav zaum ntawm cov rooj ntawd.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug told the two of us (Fong and me), “We two (Mai and I) will sit in those seats.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv qhia Fong tias, “Fong, koj zaum ntawm koj lub rooj no.”
paragraphs.english: I told Fong, “Fong, you sit in your seat here.”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv zaum ntawm no.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “Yes, I will sit here.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv tig mus rau Mai tias, “Mai, koj zaum ntawm koj lub rooj ntawd.”
paragraphs.english: I turned to Mai and said, “Mai, you sit in your seat over there.”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv zaum ntawm ntawd.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, I will sit there.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug kuj zaum ntawm nws lub rooj, thiab nws hais rau wb tias, “Kuv zaum ntawm no.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug also sat in his seat, and he said to us, “I am sitting here.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yog li, peb plaub leeg thiaj zaum ua ke.
paragraphs.english: So all four of us got to sit together.

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj tuaj xyuas peb ua ntej yeeb yam pib, thiab nws saib peb plaub leeg.
paragraphs.english: Yaj came to check on all four of us before the movie started, and he looked at all four of us.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws hais rau peb tias, “Nej plaub leeg zaum tau zoo lawm.”
paragraphs.english: He said to all four of us, “The four of you are sitting well now.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb Yaj tias, “Yog, peb zaum tau zoo lawm.”
paragraphs.english: I answered Yaj, “Yes, all four of us are sitting well.”

paragraphs.hmong: Yaj hais rau peb tias, “Nej khaws nej daim pib kom zoo, thiab nej saib yeeb yam kom lom zem.”
paragraphs.english: Yaj told all four of us, “Keep your tickets safe, and enjoy the movie.”

paragraphs.hmong: Peb teb nws tias, “Yog, peb yuav ua li ntawd.”
paragraphs.english: We answered him, “Yes, we will do that.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws hais rau peb tias, “Kuv cia nej saib yeeb yam.”
paragraphs.english: He said to all four of us, “I will let you watch the movie.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Yaj tias, “Ua tsaug rau koj.”
paragraphs.english: I said to Yaj, “Thank you.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum yeeb yam tseem tsis tau pib, muaj ib pab neeg tsib leeg los zaum pem hauv ntej peb.
paragraphs.english: Before the movie started, a group of five people came and sat in front of us.

paragraphs.hmong: Lawv tsib leeg tham nrov nrov, thiab lawv luag heev.
paragraphs.english: The five of them were talking loudly, and they were laughing a lot.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais me me rau Fong tias, “Fong, koj puas paub lawv?”
paragraphs.english: I whispered to Fong, “Fong, do you know them?”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Kuv tsis paub lawv, tiam sis lawv zoo li lom zem.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “I don’t know them, but they seem fun.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug hais me me rau wb tias, “Wb paub lawv, lawv kawm ntawv nrog wb.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug whispered to the two of us (Fong and me), “We two (Mai and I) know them — they go to school with the two of us.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum yeeb yam yuav pib, lawv tsib leeg nyob twj ywm, thiab lawv kuj saib yeeb yam.
paragraphs.english: When the movie was about to start, the five of them went quiet, and they watched the movie too.

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum yeeb yam pib, kuv ntsia pem hauv ntej thiab kuv mloog zaj yeeb yam.
paragraphs.english: When the movie started, I looked forward and listened to the movie.

paragraphs.hmong: Fong zaum ntawm kuv ib sab, ces nws kuj saib yeeb yam nrog kuv.
paragraphs.english: Fong sat beside me, so he also watched the movie with me.

paragraphs.hmong: Mai thiab Nraug zaum ntawm nkawd ob lub rooj, ces nkawd kuj saib yeeb yam nrog wb.
paragraphs.english: Mai and Nraug sat in their two seats, so the two of them also watched the movie with the two of us.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Fong tias, “Fong, koj puas nyiam yeeb yam no?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Fong, “Fong, do you like this movie?”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv nyiam nws heev.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “Yes, I like it very much.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Mai tias, “Mai, koj puas nyiam yeeb yam no?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Mai, “Mai, do you like this movie?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv nyiam nws.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, I like it.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv nug Nraug tias, “Nraug, koj puas nyiam yeeb yam no?”
paragraphs.english: I asked Nraug, “Nraug, do you like this movie?”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv nyiam nws thiab.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug answered me, “Yes, I like it too.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv pom tias peb plaub leeg yeej nyiam yeeb yam no.
paragraphs.english: I saw that all four of us really liked this movie.

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum zaj yeeb yam mus txog ib nrab, kuv saib Fong thiab nug nws tias, “Koj puas tseem xav zaum ntawm no?”
paragraphs.english: When the movie was about halfway through, I looked at Fong and asked him, “Do you still want to sit here?”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv zaum tau zoo ntawm no.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “Yes, I can sit comfortably here.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv saib Mai thiab nug nws tias, “Mai, koj puas zaum tau zoo ntawm ntawd?”
paragraphs.english: I looked at Mai and asked her, “Mai, are you sitting comfortably over there?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv zaum tau zoo ntawm ntawd.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, I am sitting comfortably there.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv saib Nraug thiab nug nws tias, “Nraug, koj puas zaum tau zoo thiab?”
paragraphs.english: I looked at Nraug and asked him, “Nraug, are you sitting comfortably too?”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug teb kuv tias, “Yog, kuv zaum tau zoo.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug answered me, “Yes, I am sitting comfortably.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv pom tias nkawd ob leeg zaum tau zoo, thiab wb ob leeg kuj zaum tau zoo.
paragraphs.english: I saw that the two of them were sitting comfortably, and the two of us were also sitting comfortably.

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum yeeb yam yuav xaus, kuv khaws kuv daim pib rau hauv kuv lub hnab.
paragraphs.english: When the movie was about to end, I put my ticket away in my bag.

paragraphs.hmong: Fong kuj khaws nws daim pib rau hauv nws lub hnab, ces wb ob leeg npaj tawm.
paragraphs.english: Fong also put his ticket in his bag, so the two of us were getting ready to leave.

paragraphs.hmong: Mai muab nws daim pib khaws cia, thiab Nraug kuj khaws nws daim pib.
paragraphs.english: Mai put her ticket away safely, and Nraug also put his ticket away.

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau nkawd tias, “Neb npaj txhij lawm los?”
paragraphs.english: I said to the two of them, “Are you two ready?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb npaj txhij lawm.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, the two of us are ready.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug hais tias, “Kuv npaj lawm thiab.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug said, “I am ready too.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau Fong tias, “Fong, koj puas npaj tawm?”
paragraphs.english: I said to Fong, “Fong, are you ready to leave?”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb tawm tau lawm.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “Yes, the two of us can leave now.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum peb tawm hauv chav saib yeeb yam, kuv pom Yaj ntawm qhov rooj.
paragraphs.english: When all four of us left the movie room, I saw Yaj at the entrance.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws saib peb thiab hais tias, “Nej puas nyiam yeeb yam?”
paragraphs.english: He looked at all four of us and asked, “Did all four of you like the movie?”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb Yaj tias, “Yog, peb nyiam heev.”
paragraphs.english: I answered Yaj, “Yes, all four of us liked it a lot.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nws nug peb tias, “Nej puas yuav rov qab tuaj saib dua?”
paragraphs.english: He asked all four of us, “Will all four of you come back to watch another movie?”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb nws tias, “Yog, wb xav rov qab tuaj.”
paragraphs.english: I answered him, “Yes, the two of us (Fong and I) want to come back.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv tig mus rau Mai thiab Nraug, ces kuv nug nkawd tias, “Neb puas xav rov qab tuaj nrog wb lwm zaus?”
paragraphs.english: I turned to Mai and Nraug, and I asked the two of them, “Do you two want to come back with the two of us another time?”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb xav rov qab tuaj.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, the two of us want to come back.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug kuj hais tias, “Kuv xav rov qab tuaj thiab.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug also said, “I want to come back too.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau sawv daws tias, “Yog li, peb plaub leeg mam rov qab tuaj ua ke lwm zaus.”
paragraphs.english: I said to everyone, “Then the four of us can come back together another time.”

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum peb npaj yuav tawm hauv tsev ntsia yeeb yam, Ntxawm thiab Nplooj pom wb ob leeg ntawm qhov rooj, hos Mai thiab Nraug tseem nyob tom qab.
paragraphs.english: When all four of us were getting ready to leave the movie theater, Ntxawm and Nplooj saw the two of us (Fong and me) at the door, while Mai and Nraug were still behind.

paragraphs.hmong: Nkawd tuaj cuag wb thiab nug wb tias, “Neb puas nyiam yeeb yam no?”
paragraphs.english: The two of them came over to us and asked us two, “Did you two like this movie?”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv teb nkawd tias, “Yog, wb nyiam heev.”
paragraphs.english: I answered the two of them, “Yes, the two of us liked it very much.”

paragraphs.hmong: Ntxawm tig mus rau Nplooj thiab hais tias, “Kuv pom lawv plaub leeg zaum ua ke.”
paragraphs.english: Ntxawm turned to Nplooj and said, “I saw all four of them sitting together.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nplooj teb Ntxawm tias, “Kuv kuj pom lawv plaub leeg.”
paragraphs.english: Nplooj answered Ntxawm, “I saw all four of them too.”

paragraphs.hmong: Ntxawm hais tias, “Lawv cov phooj ywg zoo li sib raug zoo heev.”
paragraphs.english: Ntxawm said, “Their friends seem to get along very well.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nplooj teb tias, “Yog, lawv plaub leeg zoo siab heev.”
paragraphs.english: Nplooj answered, “Yes, all four of them seem very happy.”

paragraphs.hmong: Ntxawm hais tias, “Kuv pom lawv plaub leeg tham nrog Yaj.”
paragraphs.english: Ntxawm said, “I saw the four of them talking with Yaj.”

paragraphs.hmong: Ntxawm hais ntxiv tias, “Lawv plaub leeg zaum ua ke tau zoo heev.”
paragraphs.english: Ntxawm added, “All four of them sat together very well.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nplooj hais tias, “Lawv plaub leeg zoo li muaj kev zoo siab thaum lawv ua ke.”
paragraphs.english: Nplooj said, “All four of them seem happy when they are together.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv hais rau nkawd tias, “Wb ua tsaug rau neb.”
paragraphs.english: I said to the two of them, “The two of us thank you two.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nkawd teb wb tias, “Neb txais tos.”
paragraphs.english: The two of them answered us, “You are welcome.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv tig mus rau Fong thiab hais tias, “Fong, koj puas npaj mus?”
paragraphs.english: I turned to Fong and said, “Fong, are you ready to go?”

paragraphs.hmong: Fong teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb npaj lawm.”
paragraphs.english: Fong answered me, “Yes, the two of us are ready.”

paragraphs.hmong: Kuv saib Mai thiab Nraug, ces kuv hais rau nkawd tias, “Neb, peb mus lawm.”
paragraphs.english: I looked at Mai and Nraug, and I said to the two of them, “You two, we are leaving.”

paragraphs.hmong: Mai teb kuv tias, “Yog, wb mus.”
paragraphs.english: Mai answered me, “Yes, we two are going.”

paragraphs.hmong: Nraug hais tias, “Wb rov mus ua ke.”
paragraphs.english: Nraug said, “The two of us will go together.”

paragraphs.hmong: Ces peb plaub leeg tawm tsev ntsia yeeb yam ua ke.
paragraphs.english: Then all four of us left the movie theater together.

glossary.english: Fong — one of the four friends; with the narrator, "wb ob leeg" (the two of us)
Mai — one of the four friends; with Nraug, "nkawd ob leeg" (the two of them)
Nraug — one of the four friends
Ntxawm — a friend who meets them as they leave
movie theater, cinema — where the four friends go
a seat — the numbered seats inside the theater
this — close to the speaker: "koj lub rooj no"
that, near the person spoken to — "daim pib ko", the ticket by Mai
to be apart, separated from each other
to go up to, to approach
to buy — also "will" before a verb
a number — the seat numbers 12 and 13
then; as for — adds contrast: "vim li cas koj ho nug"
then, so — the result of what came before
can, be able to, get to
to keep, to put away safely
everyone — "Kuv hais rau sawv daws", I said to everyone
to be quiet, to fall silent
to study, to go to school
the five of them — lawv because there are more than two
the four of you — nej because Yaj is talking to more than two
